statements.impact_statement: JP Assist does not call or expose zlib's gzwrite, gzprintf, gzvprintf, or non-blocking gzFile APIs required to reach gz_vacate. Python application compression uses the separate in-memory zlib interface.
statements.status_notes: Maintainer-owned exception expires 2026-11-02. Reassess sooner when the Alpine zlib package changes or when JP Assist adds native compression code.
